results.title: Untold: The Shooting at Hawthorne Hill
results.original_title: Untold: The Shooting at Hawthorne Hill
results.overview: A retired Olympic equestrian takes on a new dressage student at his idyllic farm in New Jersey. Over time, tensions mount between the two, leading to 911 calls, cryptic social media posts, and accusations of spying. The feud culminates in a shocking act of violence and a trial that rocked the prestigious and sophisticated world of dressage.

results.title: Semua Akan Baik-Baik Saja
results.overview: After their mother Mentari passes away, a group of estranged siblings must move in with their older brother Langit, forcing them to confront their personal struggles and heal old wounds to rediscover the true meaning of family.

results.title: Innamorarsi e altre pessime idee
results.overview: A successful lawyer whose wife left him for a charming chef devises a complicated plan for revenge involving a woman in trouble with the law.

results.title: Pee Nak 5
results.overview: A year after the deadly battle that finally subdued the vengeful ghost of Nak Tinn, the cycle of vengeance returns once again.

results.title: Fabian and the Deadly Wedding
results.overview: Hapless con artist Fabian crashes a quirky winter wedding, planning to steal a valuable gift meant for the bride. But when a murder disrupts his scheme, Fabian finds himself unexpectedly drawn into solving the mystery. A thrilling murder mystery comedy packed with dark secrets.

results.title: Room Service
results.overview: Derin, navigating the prepubescent blues, gets her first period in the hotel she vacations with her family. Working through her disbelief, she is determined to join her peers for a water volleyball game. When she fails to contact her mother, she thinks of the mysterious yet confident young woman sunbathing by the pool.

results.title: Cosmos
results.overview: In a forgotten village of the Yucatán, Lena, a 68-year-old widow, crosses paths with Leon, a 62-year-old Mayan guardian of nature’s secrets and spirits. Lena finds an unexpected companion in Leon. Despite their differences and seemingly opposite worlds, a deep connection forms between them—one that will bind them until death. In his new film, Germinal Roaux, one of the most unique voices of contemporary European cinema, delivers a philosophical story about aging and the decay of the body. Above all, it’s about solidarity and the small gestures of love that give meaning—and dignity—to our existence. True to the aesthetic codes established in his previous works, Roaux’s film, shot in black and white and unfolding with a ritualistic rhythm that mirrors the slow passage of time at the twilight of life, speaks poetically and with genuine emotion about the most essential bond that connects us: love.

results.title: Familia a la deriva
results.overview: To make up for lost time with his four children, a charismatic car salesman organizes a Caribbean yacht trip that quickly spirals into an out-of-control adventure filled with mix-ups, laughs, and second chances.

results.title: Cat Cam
results.overview: When two cat owners decide to put up pet cameras in their new home while they’re away on a trip, they soon make a terrifying discovery as to why their cat has been acting so strange.

results.title: The Locksmith
results.overview: The day Rodrigo, an 11-year-old boy, will read his first essay in front of the whole class, both he and those around him will discover the consequences of the peculiar relationship he has with his father and the hobbies they share.

results.title: Chongqing Pink
results.overview: Addled underworld figures Zhou Jim and Z.H. live in Los Angeles, China 2. The duo searches throughout Chinatown and Hollywood for their mind-altering substance of choice, the elusive "Chongqing Pink," with help - and hindrance! - from friends and family as they joust with the shackles of addiction.

results.title: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson
results.original_title: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson
results.overview: An intimate, arresting portrait of cyclist Moriah Wilson—raised by a fierce, loving family—whose singular drive becomes her superpower, carrying her to athletic brilliance and, devastatingly, toward a life cut short by murder.

results.title: BAGA: Tomorrow Belongs to No One
results.overview: In a conservative East Coast village, two young lovers struggle to escape poverty and tradition when an unexpected pregnancy pushes them into difficult choices, leading one to turn to drug trafficking in a desperate bid for a better future.

results.title: Mexican Psycho
results.original_title: Psicópata: El Asesino del Conejo Blanco
results.overview: Follows an "ultra-violent and intelligent" psychopath who challenges the police by leaving a white paper rabbit at each crime scene, connecting them all.

results.title: Blue Heron
results.overview: A family of six's fresh start on 1990s Vancouver Island unravels as their youngest child, Sasha, witnesses the increasingly dangerous behavior of her older brother, Jeremy.

results.title: Naa Wife Missing
results.overview: A newly married couple's happy life takes a mysterious turn when the wife suddenly disappears. As the husband seeks help, doubts about her past and hidden secrets begin to surface.

results.title: Bring Me the Horizon: L.I.V.E. in São Paulo
results.original_title: Bring Me the Horizon: L.I.V.E. in São Paulo
results.overview: BRIT-winning and Grammy-nominated band Bring Me The Horizon's biggest headline show to date. Shot at São Paulo’s Allianz Parque Stadium, performed in front of a sold-out crowd of 50,000, the film expands the visual universe of POST HUMAN by blending cinematic visuals, fan-submitted videos and showcasing characters such as E.V.E, Selene & M8. It delivers an immersive experience that rivals that electric night in Brazil. The performance spans the full evolution of BMTH’s discography, from Sempiternal and That’s the Spirit to amo and the POST HUMAN albums. L.I.V.E. in São Paulo brings the viewer in, and never lets them go.
